concept: GDP at market prices; C = household + NPISH final consumption (NE.CON.PRVT); G = general government final consumption (NE.CON.GOVT); GFCF excludes inventories (NE.GDI.FTOT); POP = de facto midyear (SP.POP.TOTL)
currency_conversion: current USD at the official annual average rate or the WB alternative conversion factor (series metadata). GTAP 12 ch.7 p.1 names WDI as the primary source
coverage_note: calendar year. Note (review S02-L6): GTAP 12 ch.7 p.1 mentions the Atlas conversion factor; we use NY.GDP.MKTP.CD (official annual average rate or the WB alternative factor), per review S02-L6 the series GTAP's own retrieval code uses

variables: GDP C G GFCF (and per-capita GDP for population)
concept: same SNA aggregates: household consumption incl. NPISH; general government final consumption; GFCF
currency_conversion: current USD at UN rates (IMF period average; PARE where the official rate is distorted) - can differ from WDI conversion
coverage_note: TZA = Mainland only; Zanzibar (EAZ) reported separately
parity_treatment: second source (F1). Components are taken as AMA shares of AMA GDP times the GDP used, so no exchange-rate basis is mixed inside one country. Where WDI has GDP, WDI GDP is kept. EAZ: zero because WDI TZA already covers the United Republic
reference: GTAP 12 ch.7 p.1-2 (UN Statistics Division); READINESS F1

concept: same SNA aggregates (private consumption, government consumption, GFCF)
currency_conversion: NT$ million; converted with the CBC annual average NT$/US$ (BP01Y01), the rate DGBAS itself uses (2021 check 28.022 vs 28.02)
parity_treatment: TWN macro (absent from WDI and AMA)

variables: report-only capital comparison K/Y = (cn x pl_n)/(cgdpo x pl_gdpo); POP for TWN
concept: cn = capital stock at current PPPs (mil. 2021 USD); pl_n = price level of the capital stock (USA 2021 = 1); cn x pl_n = capital stock in current USD at market rates
currency_conversion: K/Y is a ratio of two nominal values converted at the same PWT exchange rate, so it does not depend on the rate; applied to the GDP used, VKB takes the GDP source's exchange rate (David 2026-10-20 19:40, E30)
parity_treatment: Report-only since fix round 2 (David 2026-10-20 22:02): PWT K/Y x GDP used is compared with the GTAP-order VKB (check S02-P6); PWT nominal output vs GDP used (P5). Not a capital source.
reference: PLAN (h) step 2 [E9, E30]; Feenstra, Inklaar and Timmer (2015), AER 105(10): 3150-3182; PWT 11.0 variable definitions

concept: general government + private + PPP capital stocks, current national currency
currency_conversion: K/GDP taken in ICSD's own latest year (K over ICSD GDP_n, both national currency), applied to WDI GDP (LCU) of that year, then rolled forward to the base year in national currency (WDI NE.GDI.FTOT.CN, else NE.GDI.FTOT.CD x official rate; GDP deflator; delta 4%); K/GDP in national currency x GDP used, so no exchange rate enters
coverage_note: latest year 2019 (BLR 2014, CYP 2018, LAO 2017, LBY 2009, MKD 2018, MLT 2018, PNG 1994, SDN 2011, SUR 2011, SYR 2011, ZWE 2009); zero kgov_n+kpriv_n (ABW MAC NRU PRI SOM WBG) treated as missing
parity_treatment: Primary capital source (fix round 2, David 22:02). Then perpetual inventory over WDI real GFCF (NE.GDI.FTOT.KD) for countries without ICSD; then the geographic-average K/GDP of ICSD countries (GTAP 12 ch.7 s7.3).

concept: Gross fixed capital formation including acquisitions less disposals of valuables (SNA 2008 P.51g + P.53), as WDI NE.GDI.FTOT
currency_conversion: national currency (AED), used in the national-currency roll; no exchange rate enters
parity_treatment: Replaces missing WDI NE.GDI.FTOT.CN for ARE only (config/s02/capital_roll_sources.csv); AMA GDP and deflator equal WDI for ARE

concept: GDP at market prices, current USD (WEO NGDPD)
currency_conversion: current USD at the IMF's own conversion (WEO; for Yemen an IMF estimate in a split-currency economy)
coverage_note: countries where WDI lacks the base year and the UN AMA national-currency GDP is an imputation or below 250 USD per head (Yemen in 2022)
parity_treatment: GDP only. C, G and GFCF stay as UN AMA shares of AMA GDP times the WEO GDP, so no conversion basis is mixed inside the components

variables: GDP C G GFCF (beta v5 Cuba only)
concept: GDP at market prices and its expenditure components as the national statistics office reports them to UNSD (UN SNA table 1.1; household consumption, government consumption, GFCF)
currency_conversion: national currency converted at the listed official rate (config/s02/gdp_official_rate_2022.csv; Cuba 24 CUP per USD)
parity_treatment: Whole macro block from one table and one rate, so no basis is mixed inside the country
